miniProject.title: A traced real-code extension and reproducible research decision
miniProject.brief: Join `lmlab`'s existing study into an inspectable lifecycle, then modify one bounded mechanism in a real trainer. Keep its independent evaluation, image-text module and safety record attached to the same lineage. CPU-sized fixtures or your GPU suffice; distributed execution and another full training pipeline are not required.
steps: Join existing artifacts through a root manifest in `registry/` and a state-ownership/recovery table. Trace pinned Open Instruct arguments through labels, loss, update and publication against source; retain resolved configuration, environment and patch digests. Plant parent-identity changes and test descendant invalidation, including modality and safety branches.

Freeze whole-study predictions from independent parameter, FLOP and live-storage counts. Check CPU or single-device feasibility; retain training, rollout, evaluation, checkpoint, failed-attempt and researcher-cost budgets. Check analytical parallelism ownership/communication and resharding tables against pinned OLMo-core contracts; retain sensitivity ranges and an optional distributed-validation plan.

Implement checkpoint-consumer and rollout/scoring acceptance tests in `tests/`. Compare export logits and tokenizer round trips with the original checkpoint, resume with uninterrupted state, and request identities with independent fixtures; reject policy, tokenizer and scorer mismatches while keeping behavior scores immutable and analytical resharding claims separate.

Extend joined events with data/resume and scorer-drift incidents; identify the first invalid handoff using unchanged-output and next-batch oracles. Replay timeout, retry, late-result and interrupted-publication fixtures; require one accepted result and committed payloads. Retain root-cause regressions, all-attempt costs and identity-bound license, privacy, release and rollback gates.

Patch a bounded seam in pinned Open Instruct, OLMo-core or nanoGPT in `train/`, preserving upstream revision and patch. Inspect Open Instruct's mask tests without treating partial assertions as complete coverage; retain independent frozen-batch logits, loss, gradients, update, numerical, resume, interrupted-state and fail-before/pass-after regression evidence.

After correctness gates, compare unchanged baseline, mechanism ablation, negative control and prespecified extension across paired seeds under matched exposure, tuning and evaluation budgets. Retain raw quality/safety outcomes, failures, latency and memory; reconcile phase-scoped resource residuals and observer overhead against frozen predictions, defending against alternative designs.

Package permitted inputs, locks, manifests, tests and analysis; cleanly regenerate baseline and extension with a reviewer or explicitly labeled self-rerun. Retain transcripts and reviewer variation; generate `reports/` with claim-to-artifact links, skeptical-review responses, evidence labels, alternative-design decisions and the next smallest decisive experiment or stop.
deliverables: The root lifecycle graph, source trace, state contracts, acceptance tests and incident/retry/publication ledger in `registry/` and `tests/`.
A pinned real-code patch with independent correctness, numerical, resume and failure regressions, plus matched controls and whole-study resource reconciliation.
The clean-reproduction bundle and transcript, generated claim-linked report, skeptical-review response and bounded next-experiment decision in `reports/`.

checks.name: Open Instruct mask tests at pinned commit
checks.note: Inspect the presence and boundary assertions; supplement with independent full-label, denominator and optimizer-update oracles without fetching the default tokenizer.

rubric.pass: Your parent, consumer, retry and publication fixtures reject stale bindings, duplicate results and uncommitted artifacts. Independent joins locate both incidents; ownership, recovery, license, privacy and safety gates cover every artifact.
rubric.strong: A changed upstream identity invalidates all affected descendants without erasing attempts; export, resume and analytical changed-mesh contracts explicitly identify preserved, remapped, regenerated and rejected state.

rubric.pass: Your independent frozen-batch oracle and numerical, resume and interrupted-state regressions pass. Paired controls retain negative evidence, resource residuals and observer overhead; compare alternative designs and disclose unmatched costs.
rubric.strong: Quality, safety, compute, memory, latency and failures carry evidence or justified unmeasured labels. The optional distributed plan names topology, counters, correctness, fault injections and acceptance; unexecuted distributed claims remain unvalidated.

rubric.pass: Your bundle rebuilds evidence from permitted inputs and raw records. A reviewer executes the documented variation, or a self-rerun is labeled with independence pending; the report links claims and answers skeptical objections.
rubric.strong: Independent reproduction passes; the decision compares two alternative designs and extra-data/compute/sampling explanations, labels local, simulated, analytical and distributed evidence, and proposes a budgeted decisive experiment with falsifier and stopping rule.

miniProject.feedsInto: The capstone consumes this tested real-code extension, connected baseline and post-training lineage, clean-reproduction bundle, generated claim-linked report and skeptical-review response; the decision record supplies the next smallest decisive experiment rather than another scale-up mandate.
